第1578章 恐怖的劫数1（第1页）
杨凡所经历的雷劫实在是太过于恐怖，所以各方都不太看好他能够渡过此次雷劫。
三灾九难第一灾共分为七次雷劫，一次比一次强大。
有人甚至曾经统计过渡劫成功率，据说一万人之中只有一人成功。
大家不要忘记，杨凡的积蓄还是同等级修士的二百倍呢，这渡劫的难度还要大大增加，他渡过的成功率似乎更低。
他所渡的第一道雷劫，万蛇降世，本身就是无数修士所渡的第七道雷劫。
而第二道雷劫人形闪电本身在三灾九难之中出现的几率都是十分低的，就算出现也是一道，杨凡却是上百道，这雷劫真是变态的没法说了，现如今的第三道雷劫巨灵神雷劫乃是修士渡人仙雷劫的时候出现的一种极其恐怖的雷劫。
那巨灵神手持着巨斧，那巨斧像是开天辟地的斧子一般，虽说是雷霆凝聚而成的巨斧，但却透着无匹的锋芒，森寒而可怕，看一眼都让人有一种毛骨悚然的感觉，那巨灵神更是如同真正的神灵，身上散发出远古神灵一般的气息，不要说正在渡劫直面那巨灵神的杨凡了，就算是看杨凡渡劫的各方势力强者都感觉头皮发炸。
正在大战的六尊地仙级别强者在这一刻都不由自主的停了下来。
神族的地仙冷笑出声“三灾九难第一灾第三道雷劫就引下来了这样的雷劫，这小子完全就是一副捉死的节奏啊。”。
魔族的地仙也在幸灾乐祸“难怪这小子修为如此厉害，积蓄确实没得说，只是，呵呵，超越至尊境界便是他的极限，大鹏王，杨凡这小子很受你看中吧，现在你亲眼看着这个后辈死于雷劫之中，你的心情如何呢？说出来与我们大家一起分享分享”。
这魔族的地仙级别强者显然想要以杨凡无法渡过雷劫这件事情打击一下大鹏王。
不灭战体家族的地仙冷笑连连“这么死，还真是便宜了这个小崽子”。
大鹏王的神色十分的阴沉，他对杨凡一直都是很有信心的，可是当眼前这雷劫出现的时候，大鹏王对杨凡的信心有些动摇了，毕竟，第三道雷劫就是人仙雷劫了，第四道呢，第五道呢？
第六道呢？还有威力超过前面六道雷劫威力叠加的第七道雷劫呢？
“怎么会有这么强的雷劫，该死啊”。火鸦道人看到杨凡引下来的雷劫之后气得哇哇大叫，他对杨凡的印象一直十分之好，当初在大魔渊内第一次见到杨凡的时候就引起了火鸦道人的注意，后来杨凡又在坠仙崖之中帮助火鸦道人脱困，对于杨凡这个后辈，火鸦道人相当欣赏与看好，但是看到眼前杨凡落于危难之中他自己无法施出援手相助，火鸦道人也是相当懊恼。
只有自己，帮助自己，这一点杨凡认识的十分清楚。
第三道雷劫巨灵神出手了，手持着雷霆巨斧朝着杨凡杀来了，那声势，真的像是要开天辟地一般，可怕的无法想象。

巨斧微微一颤，周围的虚空都裂开了，这若是真正斩杀下去，威力将会多么的可怕啊？
所有人都心惊肉跳了，真是太可怕了，不用后面的雷劫，这一道便足以斩掉杨凡这小子吧？

Chapter 1578 Horrible Doom 1 (Page 1)
The thunder tribulation that Yang Fan experienced was too terrifying, so all parties were not optimistic that he could survive this thunder tribulation.
The first disaster of the Three Disasters and Nine Disasters is divided into seven thunder tribulations, each one more powerful than the last.
Someone even once calculated the success rate of transitional tribulation. It is said that only one person in 10,000 people can succeed.
Don't forget that Yang Fan's savings are still two hundred times that of monks of the same level. The difficulty of overcoming this tribulation will be greatly increased, and his success rate seems to be even lower.
The first thunder tribulation he overcame, Ten Thousand Snakes Coming to the World, was itself the seventh thunder tribulation that countless monks overcame.
The probability of the second thunder tribulation humanoid lightning itself appearing in the three disasters and nine disasters is very low. Even if it appears, it is only one, but Yang Fan has hundreds of them. This thunder tribulation is really abnormal and cannot be described. The third thunder tribulation, the giant spirit god thunder tribulation, is an extremely terrifying thunder catastrophe that occurs when monks pass through the mortal thunder tribulation.
The giant spirit god was holding a giant axe. The giant ax was like the ax that created the world. Although it was a giant ax condensed by thunder, it was extremely sharp, cold and terrifying. It gave people a creepy feeling just by looking at it. The giant spirit god was like a real god, exuding the aura of an ancient god. Not to mention Yang Fan who was facing the giant spirit god who was going through the tribulation. Even the strong men from all forces who watched Yang Fan's tribulation felt their scalps explode.
The six Earth Immortal-level experts who were fighting couldn't help but stop at this moment.
The Earth Immortal of the God Clan sneered, "Three disasters, nine disasters, the first disaster, and the third thunder disaster caused such a thunder disaster. This kid is completely in a rhythm of catching death.".
The Earth Immortal of the Demon Tribe was also gloating about his misfortune, "No wonder this boy's cultivation is so great. His savings really don't matter, but, haha, surpassing the supreme realm is his limit. King Dapeng, Yang Fan is very popular with you. Now you see this junior dying in a thunderstorm with your own eyes. How do you feel? Tell us and share it with all of us."
This Demon Clan Earth Immortal level expert obviously wanted to hit King Dapeng with the fact that Yang Fan could not survive the thunder tribulation.
The Earth Immortal from the Immortal War Body Family sneered repeatedly, "It's really an advantage for this little brat to die like this."
King Dapeng's expression was very gloomy. He had always had great confidence in Yang Fan, but when the thunder tribulation appeared in front of him, King Dapeng's confidence in Yang Fan was somewhat shaken. After all, the third thunder tribulation was the human-immortal thunder tribulation. What about the fourth, and what about the fifth?
What about the sixth path? And what about the seventh thunder tribulation that is more powerful than the combined power of the previous six thunder tribulations?
"How could there be such a powerful thunder tribulation? Damn it." Taoist Huo Ya screamed angrily after seeing the thunder disaster caused by Yang Fan. He had always had a very good impression of Yang Fan. When he first saw Yang Fan in the Great Demonic Abyss, Taoist Huo Ya caught his attention. Later, Yang Fan helped Taoist Huo Ya escape from the predicament in Falling Immortal Cliff. Taoist Huo Crow admired and valued Yang Fan very much, but when he saw Yang Fan in front of him, he could not help him. Taoist Huo Crow was also very upset.
You can only help yourself, Yang Fan knows this very clearly.
The third thunder tribulation giant spirit god took action, holding a thunder ax and heading towards Yang Fan. The momentum was really as if it was about to open up the world, and it was so terrifying that it was unimaginable.
The giant ax trembled slightly, and the surrounding void cracked. If this were to be truly killed, how terrifying would the power be?
Everyone was terrified. It was really scary. Without the thunder tribulation that followed, this one was enough to kill Yang Fan, right?
